question: Why did US inflation fall in 2023?
summary: US inflation fell in 2023: 6.4% (2022-12) -> 3.1% (2023-06 low), -3.3 pts; 2021 average 4.7%. The evidence is consistent with these drivers: (1) energy inflation (US CPI energy) fell during the 2023 decline; (2) used-car price inflation (US CPI used cars) fell during the 2023 decline; (3) food inflation (US CPI food) fell during the 2023 decline.
supported: Energy inflation (US CPI energy) fell during the 2023 decline
Food inflation (US CPI food) fell during the 2023 decline
Used-car price inflation (US CPI used cars) fell during the 2023 decline
The 12-month change in Brent crude oil prices fell during the 2023 decline
The federal funds rate rose during the 2023 decline

H1: Energy inflation (US CPI energy) fell during the 2023 decline
H2: Food inflation (US CPI food) fell during the 2023 decline
H3: Used-car price inflation (US CPI used cars) fell during the 2023 decline
H4: Shelter inflation (US CPI shelter) fell during the 2023 decline
H5: The 12-month change in Brent crude oil prices fell during the 2023 decline
H6: M2 money supply growth (12-month %) fell during the 2023 decline
H7: The federal funds rate rose during the 2023 decline
H8: US unemployment rose during the 2023 decline

reference: CPI-U inflation fell from 6.5% (Dec 2022) to 3.4% (Dec 2023); the energy index declined over the year (BLS CPI, December 2023).
